description: Build a validated RPG Maker MV event-command fragment without writing files or requiring a selected project. Returns {commands, warnings?}; feed commands to insert_event_commands, or nest them in a choice/conditional builder. kind selects the command; only fields belonging to that kind are accepted. Troop-only kinds: enemy_appear, change_enemy_state, abort_battle. Fragments omit the root end marker; complete branches include their required nested end markers. MV Show Text has four parameters (no MZ speakerName); plugin_command emits MV code 356, never MZ 357. IDs accept integers or whole decimal integer strings; constants accept finite numbers. Supported game references are checked when inserting into a project.

action.description: flow: wait requires frames; label/jump_to_label require name.

actorId.description: change_party_member/name_input: actor ID. change_actor: actor ID, 0 = entire party (or use actorVariableId).

amount.description: change_gold/change_items/change_actor hp|mp|exp|level: constant amount. Give amount or amountVariableId.

amountVariableId.description: Use this variable's value as the amount.

balloonId.description: 1-15 as in the editor list (1 exclamation).

branches.description: show_choices: one command fragment per choice. Omit for empty branches.

cancelBranch.description: show_choices: commands for a separate cancel branch.

cancelType.description: show_choices: -1 disables cancel; -2 or choices.length selects the separate cancel branch; otherwise a zero-based choice index.

characterId.description: show_animation/show_balloon/move_route: -1 player, 0 this event (default), n map event n.

condition.description: conditional_branch: switch {type,switchId,value?}; self_switch {type,name,value?}; variable {type,variableId,comparison,constant? OR variableOperand?}; actor_in_party {type,actorId}; gold {type,gold,compare?}; item {type,itemId}. Only keys for the selected type are allowed.

decrease.description: Subtract instead of add. Default false.

defaultType.description: show_choices: selected choice index, or -1 for none.

designation.description: transfer_player/show_picture: whether the coordinates are literal values or variable IDs.

effect.description: screen_effect. tint: color [r,g,b,gray] -255..255; flash: color [r,g,b,strength] 0..255; shake: power, speed 1-9.

endId.description: control_switch/control_variable: inclusive final ID; defaults to the starting ID.

enemyIndex.description: Troop slot from 0; change_enemy_state also accepts -1 for the entire troop.

faceName.description: show_text: face image basename, default empty.

goods.description: shop_processing: goods in order; omit price to use the database price.

includeEquip.description: change_items weapon/armor: also remove equipped copies.

indent.description: Base indentation, default 0. Nested branch bodies are rebased without mutating their inputs.

initialize.description: change_party_member: reset the actor when adding.

lines.description: show_text: message lines. MV does not wrap; long lines are warned about unless wrap is set.

name.description: control_switch self_switch: A-D; flow label/jump_to_label: label text; play_audio: file name without extension (empty stops the channel); show_picture: picture file.

operand.description: control_variable: {type:"constant",value}; {type:"variable",variableId}; {type:"random",min,max}; or {type:"game_data",dataType:0..7,param1?,param2?}. MZ game-data type 8 is rejected.

remove.description: change_party_member, change_actor state, change_enemy_state: remove instead of add.

repeat.description: move_route: loop the route. Default false.

scope.description: control_switch: switch requires switchId; self_switch requires name A-D.

skippable.description: move_route: skip a step that cannot be performed. Default false.

stat.description: change_actor: hp takes allowDeath; exp/level take showLevelUp; state takes stateId and remove.

steps.description: move_route: steps in order; times repeats one. toward/away are relative to the player. Parameters: jump x,y; wait frames; switch_on/off switchId; change_speed value 1-6; change_freq value 1-5; change_image name,index; change_opacity value 0-255; change_blend_mode value 0-3; play_se name,volume?,pitch?,pan?; script text.

text.description: plugin_command: full MV command string, e.g. "DoorCtl open 1".

troopId.description: battle_processing: give troopId, troopVariableId, or randomEncounter: true.

wait.description: Wait for the effect, animation, balloon or move route to finish (move_route default true).

winBranch.description: battle_processing: result branches, only when canEscape or canLose.

wrap.description: show_text: true reflows all lines as one paragraph, "hard" keeps each line as a break; both split into 4-line boxes. Width ~55 chars, ~38 with a face.

wrapWidth.description: show_text: override the wrap width in characters.

name: build_event_commands
